title: setStakedId griefable by 1-wei staker
description: setStakedId requires totalStaked == 0. Any staker holding a single unit can block owner migration indefinitely. No force-unstake mechanism exists.
remediation: Add owner-gated forceEmergencyWithdraw(address staker) callable while paused, or allow setStakedId while paused regardless of totalStaked.
